craft_notes: Sthāyin: unrefuted (three states, no refutation). Rows: row 3 (apart→refutation?). Close: there (tatrāpi as landing: even there). Rejected: 'dream is unreal, so ignore it' — killed: road kept (saraṇa as way-through, not dismissal); 'therefore Vedānta' — kept the question (no school named).

lines: Dream's road is the unreal after all; display in deep-sleep's house —
past that, in conditionless consciousness-sky, what grasp is his?
If waking's heap stood earth-firm even a moment somewhere,
then by knowing past that, this apart — what refutation even there?
l4.sanskrit_cite: svapne tāvad asatyam eva saraṇaṃ sausuptadhāmni prathā | naivāsyāsti taduttare nirupadhau cidvyomni ko 'sya grahaḥ | jāgraty eva dharāvad arthanicayaḥ syāc cet kṣaṇe kutracij | jñānenātha tadatyaye pṛthag idaṃ tatrāpi kā khaṇḍanā

reads_against.argmap: What of dream and waking? → Three-state survey ending in unrefutability: dream-road, sleep-show, waking-heap — each passed beyond by knowing, none refuted from inside.
c1_essence: Dream's road unreal, deep sleep display, waking heap earth-firm — each passed beyond by knowing, none refuted from inside.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta settling (wonder worked through to rest)
